decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location plan (16-WPR-PP-005), 16-WPR-PP-001, 16-WPR-PP-002. Received on 19 May 2016. 16-WPR-PP-003, 16-WPR-PP-004, Design and Access Statement prepared by Annie Castle dated 20 June 2016, Flood Risk Assessment prepared by Annie Castle dated 20 June 2016. Received 20 June 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension to the house
